sources.snippet: Scalpel-VL-1.6B achieves 40% faster inference speed than Qwen3-VL-2B with similar parameter magnitude; Its end-to-end inference latency is comparable to Qwen3.5-0.8B, a dense model with half its parameter count; Within models of equivalent parameter scale, Scalpel-VL-1.6B establishes state-of-the-art performance across both prediction accuracy and inference latency.

sources.title: FreeModel — One API for every frontier model
sources.snippet: What is FreeModel A multi-model gateway, delivered as one API. Instead of committing to a single vendor, FreeModel sits in front of a pool of the strongest open models and routes every request to the one most likely to nail it. You call one endpoint — in either the OpenAI or the Anthropic format — and we handle model selection, switching, and fallback underneath.
